mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(c.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(c.document_id) AS documentId, RAWTOHEX(c.document_version_id) AS documentVersionId, RAWTOHEX(c.template_version_id) AS templateVersionId, RAWTOHEX(c.requested_by) AS requestedBy, c.status, c.total_issue_count AS totalIssueCount, c.blocking_issue_count AS blockingIssueCount, TO_CHAR(c.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS startedAt, TO_CHAR(c.finished_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS finishedAt, c.result_summary AS resultSummary
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_format_check (id, document_id, document_version_id, template_version_id, requested_by, status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{check.id}), HEXTORAW(#{check.documentId}), HEXTORAW(#{check.documentVersionId}), HEXTORAW(#{check.templateVersionId}), HEXTORAW(#{check.requestedBy}), #{check.status})

INSERT INTO edudoc_format_check (id, document_id, document_version_id, template_version_id, requested_by, status, result_summary, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{check.id}), HEXTORAW(#{check.documentId}), HEXTORAW(#{check.documentVersionId}), HEXTORAW(#{check.templateVersionId}), HEXTORAW(#{check.requestedBy}), 'ERROR', #{check.resultSummary, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_format_check c WHERE c.id = HEXTORAW(#{checkId})

SELECT FROM edudoc_format_check c WHERE c.document_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentVersionId}) AND c.template_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{templateVersionId}) AND c.requested_by = HEXTORAW(#{requestedBy})
AND (c.status = 'QUEUED' OR (c.status = 'RUNNING' AND c.started_at > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE)) ORDER BY c.create_time DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_format_check SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{checkId}) AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE edudoc_format_check SET status = #{status}, total_issue_count = #{totalIssueCount}, blocking_issue_count = #{blockingIssueCount}, result_summary = #{resultSummary}, finished_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{checkId}) AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE edudoc_format_check SET status = 'ERROR', result_summary = #{resultSummary}, finished_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{checkId}) AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(d.template_version_id) FROM edudoc_document d WHERE d.id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId})

SELECT RAWTOHEX(t.current_version_id) FROM edudoc_template t WHERE t.course_id = HEXTORAW(#{courseId}) AND t.status = 'P' AND t.current_version_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.update_time DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
